name: Agents Anywhere — Workspace Chat Beta
description: Opt-in workspace chat through the current Agents Anywhere Connector protocol: discover, create, send, sync replies, interrupt and reconnect.

en.name: Agents Anywhere — Workspace Chat Beta
en.description: Share the selected workspace's Pi sessions with Agents Anywhere. Discover sessions, create chats, send messages, sync text replies and interrupt turns.
en.safetyNotes: High risk: separate sharing consent uploads workspace paths, session titles, user/assistant text, model identifiers and status to the declared server and permits remote prompts and interruption under existing session permissions. New sessions require native Ask confirmation. Address, Connector ID and scoped session receipts persist locally. Optional token storage uses password-derived AES-256-GCM encryption; the password is never saved. Weak passwords allow offline guessing. Restart requires unlock and new sharing consent; uninstall may remove saved data. No pasted command execution or approval bypass. Disconnect does not abort accepted turns. Cloud acceptance and host redirect security review remain pending.

zh-CN.name: Agents Anywhere — 工作区聊天 Beta
zh-CN.description: 经单独确认后共享当前工作区的 Pi 会话，支持发现会话、新建聊天、发送消息、同步文字回复和中断任务。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 高风险：单独确认共享后，将工作区路径、标题、用户及助手文字、模型标识和状态上传至声明服务器，并允许按会话现有权限远程发消息及中断。新会话须通过宿主 Ask 确认。本地保存地址、连接器 ID 和分域会话回执；可选使用密码派生密钥及 AES-256-GCM 加密保存令牌，密码不保存。弱密码可能遭离线猜解。重启需解锁并重新确认共享；卸载可能清除数据。不执行粘贴命令，不绕过审批。断开不终止已接收任务。Cloud 验收及宿主重定向安全核验仍待完成。

author: PI-Desktop Plugin Contributors
changelog: 2.0.0-beta.3: restore connection address/ID after reload, optionally persist the token encrypted with a user password, unlock only during explicit connection, and forget connection settings without deleting session mappings. No auto-connect or persisted sharing consent. Permissions and official-host allowlist unchanged; self-hosted support awaits a future host API.
